subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into current sub-agent guidance, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining choice is prompt-policy direction across model-facing guidance and nested sub-agent semantics, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose that outcome.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into the current availability- and depth-aware Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or sub-agent prompt surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, change runtime depth behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests in the same PR.

options.title: Pause As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is sufficient, leave or close this protected branch by maintainer decision without carrying the stale rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into the current availability- and depth-aware Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or sub-agent prompt surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged nested sub-agent orchestration work defines the depth-aware runtime and prompt contract this PR would alter.
